blocks.html: Within one month after a request from the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission, the Department of City Planning shall make a report, based upon information from the Department of Education and other appropriate City Departments, on the anticipated effect of the proposed large-scale residential development on the existing capacity of public schools or other public facilities serving the area in which the proposed large-scale residential development is to be located.
blocks.plainText: Within one month after a request from the Chairperson of the City Planning Commission, the Department of City Planning shall make a report, based upon information from the Department of Education and other appropriate City Departments, on the anticipated effect of the proposed large-scale residential development on the existing capacity of public schools or other public facilities serving the area in which the proposed large-scale residential development is to be located.
